reviews.comment:
Estoy totalmente decepcionado con el trato de la sucursal del ACA Av Cabido.
Tengo mas de 20 años de socio y ultimamente he visto un total destrato del personal de las oficinas hacia los socios.
Ademas consulte hace unos dias sobre un service de Cambio de aceite y filtros y me tomaron el turno para dos dias mas adelante para darles tiempo a conseguir los filtros de mi auto importado, supuestamente no consiguieron pero no me avisaron absolutamente nada. Mi Sra falto al trabajo para llevar el auto a la hora del turno y la atendieron con impresentable desden de parte del encargado de mecanica y del impresentable mecanico de YPF.
Realmente lamentable todo.
Mi reflexion para los empleados si no les gusta o estan desconformes con el trabajo que hacen busquen otro, pero no se lo desquiten con los socios, ya que gracias a ellos cobran su sueldo.
Saludos

(Translated by Google)
I am completely disappointed with the treatment I receive at the ACA Av. Cabido branch.
I have been a member for over 20 years, and lately I have witnessed a total lack of respect from the office staff towards members.
Furthermore, a few days ago I inquired about an oil and filter change service, and they scheduled me for two days later to give them time to obtain the filters for my imported car. Supposedly, they couldn't get them, but they didn't notify me at all. My wife missed work to bring the car in on time for the appointment, and she was treated with appalling disdain by both the mechanic manager and the equally unprofessional mechanic at the YPF gas station.
It's truly deplorable.
My advice to the employees: if you don't like or are dissatisfied with your work, find another job, but don't take it out on the members, since it is thanks to them that you receive your salary.
Regards
